packageRules.description: Never update this repository's references to ITSELF. workflow-templates/gitleaks.yml references FlowMatrix-AI/.github, and it cannot use a local './' ref the way .github/workflows/secret-scan.yml now does -- the Actions template picker copies that file verbatim into OTHER repos, where './.github/workflows/gitleaks.yml' would resolve to a file that does not exist. Left managed, Renovate chases this repo's own HEAD -- pinning the branch ref to a digest, then bumping that digest to each new HEAD it creates, week after week: of the 11 commits before this rule, 8 were that self-chase (a 9th was an unrelated actions/checkout bump). Each one also reset renovate/stability-days on every downstream 'flowmatrix-ai/.github digest' PR in the org, so five of them sat pending for 45-54 days and could never reach the 3-day soak that gates automerge. The template therefore references @main rather than a digest: a digest would be frozen by this rule and drift, so a repo adopting the template later would inherit whatever gitleaks.yml looked like the day the pin was last touched. An adopting repo runs its own Renovate, which pins the reference to a digest on its first run.
